name: El Santuario de Chimayó

dates.altered: The survey records a tin roof and wooden towers as recent additions made before 1929, and the purchase of the chapel in October 1929 by the Society for the Preservation and Restoration of New Mexico Mission Churches, which turned it over to the Roman Catholic Church.
dates.note: The survey prints 'Date, of Erection: 1816' and the Wikipedia infobox 'Built 1816'. The survey places the chapel in Santa Fe County; the Library's item title and Wikipedia say Rio Arriba County.
